source_title: Patreon And A New Adventure Begins

snippets.snippet_text: "Many reasons, first of all, it's a platform that is well known and used by many other Skyrim modders like me, so it's easier to get a following since many of the players already have an account and are following other creators. My Skyrim mods are and will always be free for everyone, but I needed a place where I have full control of my content, were the rules are clear and I don't have to change my way of making and sharing mods to adapt to a 'mysterious algorithm', and it has the best integration with other platforms."

"I already have a plugin to connect with my website so I can give users access to the protected posts with their Patreon login, based on their tier, for better formatting and an optimized reading experience."

possible_subjects: Patreon seller experience (May 2025): Skyrim modder cites established creator network, no opaque algorithm, full content control, and strong platform integrations as reasons for choosing Patreon
